tldr: Mercury in the 8th house routes the mind and voice through shared depth and vulnerability.
body: With Mercury in the 8th house, thinking, speech, learning, writing, business, and the way the mind makes connections move through shared resources, trust, intimacy, debt, grief, and deep repair. This makes how you merge, trust, release control, and handle what cannot stay superficial a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening. Left unconscious, it can become overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it.
gift: language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through shared depth and vulnerability.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it concentrated in shared depth and vulnerability.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
